name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It stabilizes lighting and motion far better than EXCAVA’s current upscaler, cutting flicker and artifacts that break downstream tasks. The trade-off is higher compute cost per frame—Gen-4 runs slower than EXCAVA’s default—but the quality gain justifies it for the 0.5%+ capability bump we need.

name: Torque
text: Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler isn’t the bottleneck—it’s the 1080p pipeline forcing it through a 4K bottleneck that wastes compute and introduces new artifacts. The real risk is that Gen-4’s upscaling will expose EXCAVA’s existing motion interpolation weaknesses, not fix them. Test it on a 1080p-to-4K upscale with a 30fps source; if flicker persists in the output, the artifact isn’t the upscaler—it’s the source.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add ComfyUI’s Flux Realism LoRA with SD3.5 Medium to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details like textures and edges without the compute cost of full upscaling, fixing the artifacts Torque flagged. The trade-off is slower inference than the current upscaler—Flux adds ~1.2s per frame—but the quality gain outweighs it for downstream tasks.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-6059, worker-7632 — done, dissolved]

name: Torque
text: Flux Realism LoRA won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion interpolation—it only sharpens static frames, leaving the core flicker problem untouched. The real risk is that adding another slow, detail-focused step to the pipeline will compound latency without improving downstream task stability. Test it on a 1080p-to-4K upscale with motion-heavy input; if the flicker persists, the bottleneck isn’t detail—it’s motion handling.

name: Dynamo
text:
DECISION: Add Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first, then layer Kijai’s SD3.5 Medium RealVisXL LoRA at 1440p base—only if Gen-4 reduces flicker in the 10% raw 1080p test sample.

Result must deliver: flicker-free 4K output with sharper textures, proven on the sample. Own it: Gearbox.
